definition: Processing time divided by audio duration: RTF 0.1 means transcribing or synthesizing 10 seconds of audio per second of compute.
details: Processing time divided by audio duration: RTF 0.1 means transcribing or synthesizing 10 seconds of audio per second of compute. The core speech-serving throughput metric, alongside first-audio latency for interactive TTS.

explainer.lead: Real-time factor is processing time divided by audio duration. It matters because it tells you whether a speech system runs faster than the audio it handles.

tiers.eli5: If it takes one second to process ten seconds of sound, the factor is 0.1—ten times faster than playback.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use RTF to size speech serving capacity, alongside first-audio latency for interactive TTS. Pitfall: an average RTF below one can still hide slow starts that hurt interactivity.
tiers.paperLevel: RTF = processing time / audio duration; RTF 0.1 means 10 seconds of audio handled per second of compute. It is a throughput metric and does not capture latency to first output.

explainer.example: Transcribing 60 seconds of audio in 6 seconds gives RTF 0.1.
